title: Context-Aware Eyelid Cancer Detection using Vision Transformers
description: MSc dissertation project at Trinity College Dublin: a two-stage ViT-B/16 pipeline that first learns normal periocular anatomy through self-supervised MAE pretraining (10k+ healthy eye images), then fine-tunes on a labelled eyelid-cancer dataset to classify lesions as benign or malignant — validated against an ImageNet-initialised baseline via ablation and interpreted with Grad-CAM.

title: LegalAssist — AI Legal Assistant
description: An AI assistant giving lawyers and junior advocates on-demand legal expertise: a chat frontend backed by a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline, where semantic search over legal-document vector embeddings grounds a dedicated text-generation service in real source material.

title: NeuroIntel — Multiple Disease Predictor
description: An integrated diagnostic webapp combining imaging analysis with a symptom-based diagnosis module to improve neural-disorder prediction accuracy, covering Alzheimer's, brain tumor, and brain stroke detection alongside ML models for diabetes, heart, kidney, liver, and malaria. Built with Flask and deployed on Heroku; published as first-author research in IRJAEH, December 2024.

title: Meme Museum
description: A full-stack webapp for generating, storing, and sharing memes from a keyword, with user accounts, IBM App ID authentication, and an admin panel for content moderation. Built with Flask, MongoDB, Express, and IBM Db2.
